name: Recanto das Emas

queries.query: Recanto das Emas Brazil official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Distrito Federal SEDUH IDE-DF
queries.result: First-party discovery found SEDUH's official Geoportal page and the IDE-DF public ArcGIS REST service. The service exposes the Cadastro Territorial registered-lot layer and identifies Recanto das Emas in the regional-administration layer.

queries.query: Recanto das Emas cadastro predial mapa de lotes parcelas Geoportal oficial Brasília Distrito Federal
queries.result: Portuguese first-party discovery found the public SEDUH GeoPortal, the official Parcelamentos do Solo consultation portal listing RA-XV - Recanto das Emas, and the IDE-DF public service. The service's RA-XV filter returned bounded registered-lot geometry.

registryEvidence.custodian: Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Urbano e Habitação do Distrito Federal (SEDUH), through the IDE-DF public Cadastro Territorial service and SEDUH Geoportal.
registryEvidence.localScope: The public service's registered-lot layer contains pu_ra=15 records, and the official regional-administration layer identifies code 15 as RECANTO DAS EMAS. This is local Distrito Federal cadastral/map evidence, not merely national-agency prose.

parcelDiscovery.source: IDE-DF Publico/CADASTRO_TERRITORIAL MapServer layer 10, Lotes Registrados
parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:31983 source; sample returned by server with outSR=4326
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: where=pu_ra=15, outFields=objectid, returnGeometry=true, resultRecordCount=3, orderByFields=objectid ASC, outSR=4326

fieldMapping.nativeIdentity: objectid (ArcGIS OID; retained as GeoJSON properties.id string)

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point query returned zero registered-lot features and the identified-occupation query also returned zero. These are point-level misses only; the RA-XV bounded query established local coverage and supplied three retained polygons. No coordinate was shifted.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 via first-party discovery; SEDUH states the GeoPortal is public and provides cartographic information and exact lot location.
HTTP 200 via first-party discovery; official portal lists RA-XV - Recanto das Emas.
HTTP 200; service metadata identifies SEDUH Cadastro Territorial, layers including Lotes Registrados and Ocupações Identificadas, supported JSON/GeoJSON queries, and EPSG:31983.
HTTP 200; layer metadata identifies polygon geometry, native objectid OID, pu_ra, and shape. Unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax/account fields were not requested.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON with zero features for the exact WUP point in EPSG:4326; treated only as an exact-point miss.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON with zero features for identified occupations at the exact WUP point; treated only as an exact-point miss.
HTTP 200 JSON; point fell in administrative region objectid 97, ra_cira 15, ra_nome RECANTO DAS EMAS.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON; bounded response returned three full polygons with native objectids 2, 3, and 4 and exceededTransferLimit=true, indicating additional records exist; only three were retained.

uncertainty: Lotes Registrados is an official Distrito Federal cadastral/urban-lot map layer and may not equal the complete legal cadastral fabric or title registry dataset.
The exact WUP point fell outside a returned registered-lot polygon; the point was not moved and the miss was not generalized.
The sample is limited to three records from a bounded pu_ra=15 query; it is not citywide completeness evidence.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
Independent serial review is required before adapter or runtime qualification.
